head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Many gaps in this chunk are already in the known ledger and were not re-reported: acdsl-policy-guard, nightly gating, bootstrap dry-run-only coverage, the sync_settings marker, the .serena husk, the remote-FROM squash, the cache from_tip and truncation clauses, and others. Not reported because it is close to known tests-NIT-71-r1 (print_agent_worktrees_status.sh:266): no cache test advances an agent branch tip after the cache is warm, and no test plants a v1-keyed row, so dropping $tip| or |v2 from cache_key also keeps the suite green. Cross-direction notes for the station (not tests findings): (1) routines/skill-eval/briefs/fexplore/applied-probe-safety.md:3 and the skill-eval plist ROUTINE_EVAL_QUALITY_CONTEXT point at plans/archived/applied_probe_safety/..., but at head plans/ holds only plans/v1-2-1/ (commit a342811 renamed archived), so eval cells get a concept path that does not exist and the quality context file is missing; matrix.sh write_manifest never checks qualityContext existence. (2) skill-invoke-gate.sh:52's deny text says the Skill must be invoked '(bare, no args)', but railroad lanes are told to pass args=lane:<direction>; the gate matches on .input.skill alone, so it works, but the message contradicts the skill contract. Shell tests were not executed in-lane (the lane shell policy forbids running scripts with bash); head build and test health comes from the dispatcher buildtest.

findings.claim: The gate's FIRST-user-message-only marker scope is unpinned: every transcript in test_skill_invoke_gate.sh holds exactly one user line, so widening the jq at skill-invoke-gate.sh:27-30 from `[ ... select(.type == "user") ][0]` to all user lines keeps the suite green, although real transcripts carry tool_result content as type:"user" lines and an ordinary session that reads any file quoting "REQUIRE-SKILL:<name>" would then be denied every non-Skill tool call.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh:27-32 (first_user = [ .[] | select(.type == "user") ][0].message.content; required parsed from it) and cmd/tests/test_skill_invoke_gate.sh:33-44,92-93: user_line emits one user line per transcript, and t_no_marker/t_marker_only/t_slash/t_invoked/t_wrong_skill/slash_marker each start with their only user line; no transcript appends a later user line (tool_result or text) carrying a marker. Sequence: change [0] to map over all user lines -> test_no_marker_is_silent still uses a marker-free single line -> all 9 tests pass. Not in the known ledger (NIT-54-r1 covers only the string-content branch).
findings.fix: Add a case to test_skill_invoke_gate.sh: transcript = user_line "$plain_txt" followed by a user tool_result line containing "REQUIRE-SKILL:railroad-review"; assert a Bash call stays silent.
